text: Confirmed and filed #6582: VFP9 SP2 `ERASE erase_target.txt` deletes a bare relative filename (COM probe; Language Reference permits unquoted names), while Copperfin evaluates the operand and errors `OLE object not found for property read: erase_target.txt`; quoted control works. Duplicate search found no ERASE issue; sibling bare-filename issues #6562/#6563/#6565 cover different command paths. #6582 is open, owner-authored, and labeled bug/runtime/agent-approved. No production changes made.
